Class 11 Student Stabbed to Death in Delhi After Dispute

A 20-year-old Class 11 student was fatally stabbed in Delhi following a dispute. The incident occurred in the Kalkaji area of South Delhi. Police have identified the accused and arrested two individuals in connection with the stabbing. The motive behind the attack is still under investigation.
